changeSet.sql: -- Split full_name on first space: first word -> first_name, rest -> last_name -- If no space exists, duplicate value in both fields UPDATE exhibitor SET first_name = CASE WHEN POSITION(' ' IN TRIM(full_name)) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(full_name) FROM 1 FOR POSITION(' ' IN TRIM(full_name)) - 1)) ELSE TRIM(full_name) END, last_name = CASE WHEN POSITION(' ' IN TRIM(full_name)) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(full_name) FROM POSITION(' ' IN TRIM(full_name)) + 1)) ELSE TRIM(full_name) END WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL;

-- Split full_name on first space: first word -> first_name, rest -> last_name -- If no space exists, duplicate value in both fields UPDATE exhibitor SET first_name = CASE WHEN LOCATE(' ', TRIM(full_name)) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(full_name), 1, LOCATE(' ', TRIM(full_name)) - 1)) ELSE TRIM(full_name) END, last_name = CASE WHEN LOCATE(' ', TRIM(full_name)) > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING(TRIM(full_name), LOCATE(' ', TRIM(full_name)) + 1)) ELSE TRIM(full_name) END WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL;
